dedupe_keys.name: grow africa georeferenced crop yield database v2 0 1960 2023

description: An Africa-wide database of georeferenced crop yield observations. The Zenodo record says GROW-Africa version 2.0 holds 535,844 georeferenced yield observations across Africa for 1960 to 2023, mostly 2000 to 2023, for 25 crops including maize, sorghum, cassava, groundnuts, cowpeas, rice, yams and millet, drawn from regional government statistics, household surveys and plot-level crop cuts. It is meant for analysis of yield trends and for training satellite yield estimation, and is described in Geyman et al. 2025 in Scientific Data. The files (database zip of 64.6 MB, spatial and GADM look-up tables, MATLAB code and the manuscript) are free to download under CC BY 4.0, published 12 August 2025. Coverage is Africa. Caveats: sources differ in scale and method, so observations are not directly comparable. For simulation it gives baseline and shock-year yields to calibrate drought impact models for African agriculture. A related catalogue record is the LSMS-ISA household surveys.
